key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

weapon.description: Melee and ranged weapons. Weapons have two primary classification axes: (1) damage.type (slashing/bludgeoning/piercing maps to the blades/blunt/piercing combat skills), and (2) length (short/normal/reach) which also controls attackReach in 'units of length' (reach = 2 units). short + normal are typically one-handed; reach weapons are two-handed. Each weapon declares its governing 'skill' and 'attackReach'. Base damage uses classic D&D 3.5-style dice. Material-based variations and crafting restrictions are documented in docs/modules/weapons.md rather than enforced in the base schema.

length.description: Physical length / engagement category of the weapon. Determines both handedness and attack reach in discrete 'units of length'. short and normal weapons are typically one-handed and attack 1 unit. Reach weapons are two-handed and can attack 2 units of length. One of the two primary weapon classification axes (the other being damage.type, which maps to blades/blunt/piercing skills).

skill.description: The skill used to make attack rolls with this weapon. For melee this is normally derived from damage.type (slashing → blades, bludgeoning → blunt, piercing → piercing). Ranged weapons use marksmanship.

attackReach.description: How many units of length this weapon can attack in melee. Most weapons (short/normal) have 1; reach weapons have 2. This is determined by the length category but stored explicitly for clarity.

consumable.description: A consumable or applied item (potion, poison, coating, oil, food) whose effects are drawn from the shared effect registry.

delivery.description: How the item is used: drink/eat (self), apply_weapon (poisons/coatings/oils), throw (bombs)

uses.description: Number of applications/charges; e.g. a weapon coating may last several hits
